quest.title: Ere the End, a Glance Back
quest.description: As it turns out, the one behind the missing person case is a cursed blade that has possessed Amenoma Yuuya's body. To save the latter and to prove the absurdity of the blade's fixation, Kazuha eventually takes up the cursed blade himself.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x575, Primogem x60, Mora x38100, Guide to Diligence x5, Unknown Item #11416 x1, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

talks.objective: Enter the occupied hold and defeat the opponents

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How are you feeling? You okay?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I am alright. The blade is performing largely as I expected. Having gone so long without proper use and maintenance, it's become very difficult to use.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Though he's making every effort to persevere, I do not think he can last much longer.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Something else on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: How strange. Rather than trying to control me, he is instead trying to match my fighting rhythm.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Let's keep going.

talks.objective: Keep going and defeat the opponents

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, something's up with the blade!

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I can sense that his strength is slowly fading away. The blade is becoming more and more difficult for me to wield.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: He cannot hold out much longer. If he keeps persisting, he will likely break apart at any moment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... what would that do to Amenoma Yuuya...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I will be careful with it. He also says he does not have any plans to give up easily.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: He's still trying to achieve his goal...

talks.objective: Keep going and defeat the opponents

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you okay? It looked like you were really struggling the entire fight.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes. And it looks like he's reached his limit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The sheen's grown a bit dimmer again. It doesn't look anywhere near as impressive as it did at the start.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Perhaps this time, we'll finally have a chance to see his true form.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: True form? What are you talking about... Huh? What the...!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this the same blade as before!? It looks like a piece of junk!

choices.text: The wear and tear is severe.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If you choose to continue in the state you're in, you wouldn't even be able to beat samurai and kairagi, much less the Almighty Shogun.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Maybe you truly did wield the power to rival the Shogun's light when first forged. But the long journey from Snezhnaya back to Inazuma has left you battered and broken.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It barely needs stating anymore. Your ambition is a flight of fancy.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I've finally figured out why it was that you agreed to my bet.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: You wanted to reach a state of harmony with me. For perhaps then, you would still be able to wield commendable power.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But regrettably, we are nothing alike. I will never understand your obstinacy and cruelty, nor can I empathize with the one who made you.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The only one who truly understood you had already passed away by the time you were born.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What's that supposed to mean?

response.speaker: Murayama
response.text: There they are. Take them down!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah! Where do they keep coming from!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You shouldn't fight with this blade anymore.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup yup, we can help this time!

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Don't worry, I'll use my own blade.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It's just more of the same.

choices.text: Though the truth is right there in front of him.
It really looks like it's about to break.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was such a close call...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: My apologies... in the end, I still needed your help.

talks.objective: Keep going and defeat the opponents

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You fought way better with your own sword.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: ...You are a true Kaedehara, in flesh and in spirit. Though we fought briefly together, you have seen me for who I really am.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: No one knew anything of my story throughout my travels, nor did I tell it to anyone. You are the first person to know the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I thought that if I could achieve Isshin harmony with you, perhaps there would still be a ray of hope for me.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But in this, too, you have failed.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Indeed. No matter how hard I tried, I could not attain that perfect harmony that your personal blade does with you.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Too much time has passed... My physical state is poor, and without proper maintenance, I can only disguise my true appearance behind an outer sheen.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Yours is the blade that took on the Musou no Hitotachi... And what a magnificent blade it is. Perhaps I shall never reach that level of glory...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Actually... this is just a generic blade that I picked up during my travels in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Wh—What?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Forging and maintenance are both important for a blade, but they are not everything.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: This blade has traveled the land with me for many years, and we have formed a close bond during that time. Plus, in the moment that I most needed it, I received aid from another power...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Skill, blade, determination, and desire — all these must be aligned in the practice of Isshin Art.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: There is something else I must tell you. Though your maker may not have been aware, your ability to possess your own consciousness derived from the power of the Tatarigami.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Tatarigami is a malevolence from the ancient past. It is the source of your mania and savagery.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Though you tried to cooperate with me while I was wielding you, the part of you driven by Tatarigami was constantly trying to seize control of my body.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I sensed it, but I couldn't change it. It is an integral part of my consciousness.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I resisted its temptations because I wanted to save Amenoma Yuuya. But I do not know whether you yourself have any intention of trying to fight it.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I feel a great sense of regret for you, since you embarked on a journey bound for a destination you were destined never to reach.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The moment you embarked on this journey, you lost the only person who could have ever unleashed your true potential. And yet there was no way for you to turn your back on his ambition.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You have known this for a long time. It is the true source of your despair.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: He gave me everything... my life, my form, my consciousness and purpose...

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: How could I possibly deny him his wish...

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I said to him, "Do not worry. From here on, I shall forge your legacy."

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: How could I go back on my word...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I believe our bet is now settled. I have nothing further to say.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where are you going, Kazuha?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: He now has neither the ability, nor the motivation to cause further harm. Let's give him some time to reflect on things.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: When I touched the hilt for the first time, it's as if I was transported to a strange dimension. It was somewhere I've never been.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: A bladesmith lay quietly on the bed, his frail face barely visible under the moonlight. His breaths were weak, and his life near its end.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: A newly forged blade lay by his side, listening attentively to his final words.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... that was the blade's memory, wasn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Indeed. While in exile in Snezhnaya, the bladesmith eventually learned the truth behind everything that had happened. The Isshin Art had been dealt a devastating blow by the desertion of its best smiths.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: He spent the rest of his life in the forge, not to vent his frustration and hatred, but to atone for his actions.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: He felt intense regret at being tricked by the Fatui, but he could never again return to his homeland. His sole wish was to one day return his single proudest creation back to the land of his birth.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: So he instructed this sentient blade to find a way back to Inazuma, no matter how long or how hard the journey. But he never wished to rival the gods...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: All he wanted to show was that they once shone brilliantly as blade and smith, that they were still worthy of being trusted.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's the true story...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But after that, the blacksmith's intentions were warped by the Tatarigami, slowly turning his proud creation into the cursed blade of today.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Right. I believe the bladesmith might never have known that the power he worked with was that of the Tatarigami. The hatred within that power is what sent the blade down its ill-fated path.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: This blade has committed unforgivable atrocities, but only because it lost its original master. No one was there to correct its errors when it was losing its way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Shame it's too late now.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes, it is too late.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Time would not wait or stop because of his determination. While the world moved on, his ambition remained stubbornly stuck at that fleeting moment at the dawn of his journey.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: He seems to have calmed down though. Let's go and check in.

talks.objective: Listen to what the cursed blade has to say

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: When I look back at the past, I can remember the day of my forging like it was just yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I once told him that I would pay any price to fulfill his wishes, such was the debt I owed to him for giving me the gift of consciousness.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: But darkness and slaughter numb the mind. Over time, I lost sight of the difference between gratitude and grudge.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Not only did I fail to fulfill his ambition... I also defiled it...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You are finally seeing reality clearly.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Since we agreed to the terms of the bet, I will honor the agreement, and release Amenoma Yuuya.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: But I still cannot bring myself to forsake his ambition. It is the entire purpose for my existence.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: So, may I ask you to help me fulfill the ambitions of myself and my creator?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, now you're adding yours into the mix, too? Geez, don't push your luck mister!

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: It has to be done in this order. At least hear what I have to say... and if you don't agree, I will still release Amenoma Yuuya as promised.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: My physical form, as well as the knowledge I possess, should still be of some value to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: His attitude has grown a lot milder...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you think, Kazuha? Should we give him a chance?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Let's hear it.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Thank you all. When I was first forged, my maker was already terminally ill. He told me that he had wanted me to have the grandest opening battle.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Alas, after that, he never rose from his sickbed again...

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Nor have I ever had the chance to prove myself in battle since.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: My fights were devoid of any noble meaning. They were merely the next step in my never-ending journey... the next in a long line of transgressions.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: You are a fine warrior. I would like to request your hand in battle, and experience a true duel between samurai.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Oh, and who would be the opponent?

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I will release Amenoma Yuuya, and restore his consciousness. Perhaps after that, you can convince him to commit to a fight with you.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: He must have plenty of reasons to both hate me and desire a good fight.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Understood. Then let's start by waking him up and seeing if he has the stamina and will to fight.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Amenoma Yuuya finally regains consciousness. The party explains the situation to him.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: I see. He used my body... to inflict harm on others.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: I utterly despise him and his actions, but since he stayed true to your agreement by releasing me, he must still have some remaining semblance of honor.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: If a duel can help to set this state of affairs in order, I am willing to put myself forward.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: I do not wish to be a mere victim in this story.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's no need to worry, we'll vouch for your innocence to the Tenryou Commission!

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help. Who knows how this would have ended without your intervention.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Alright, then let's move on.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: More ronin could appear at any moment. We can't stay here.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: In any case, for a final duel, I think we should aim for a greater sense of ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This reminds Paimon a bit of The Crux Clash.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That was a much more relaxed occasion.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup, we still can't let our guard down, even now. Paimon has a sneaking suspicion that blade hasn't told us everything...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still... even if he's way past the point of redemption, it's hard not to feel a teensy bit sorry for him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you ready?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Ready?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...Okay. Alright then.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Successor of Isshin Art, Kaedehara Kazuha.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: Successor of Amenoma Art, Amenoma Yuuya.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Honored to cross blades with you.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: It is my honor also.

talks.objective: Have a duel with Amenoma Yuuya
Have a duel with Amenoma Yuuya

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: ...Thank you for the experience.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: Although he appears battered and broken, in your hands, it seems he's regained a glimmer of brilliance.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: His sense of savage cruelty has completely faded away, but that same sense of determination remains strong.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You also fought well. I'm sure he relished the experience.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: There are a few things that I shall leave him to tell you himself.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I must apologize to you for all that has transpired.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: You need not seek my forgiveness, nor do I have the right to forgive you on your victims' behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: It is too late for all of that.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I do not wish for forgiveness. I only hope that you will see my transgressions as mine alone, and not let them stain the legacy of Isshin Art.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I strayed far from the straight and narrow path, but the Isshin Art still has a worthy successor in Kaedehara Kazuha.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I beseech you... please understand this.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: Yes. I, too, trust Mr. Kaedehara to do the right thing.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Thank you, successor of Amenoma Art.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: This blade has also told me that he has another wish: He would like to visit the Amenoma Smithy.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Maybe we can go back there together.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What does he want to go there for?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I'm not sure. But I think that all this is about to come to an end.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Ah, it's Yuuya! You have returned!

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Yuuya
dialogues.text: I am sorry to have troubled you. It's all thanks to them that I was able to return safely.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Amenoma Tougo about the various things that happened.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: A prized Isshin blade, turned weapon that controls the human mind...

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: *sigh* Considering their forging philosophy, this was indeed within the realm of possibility. This is a great pity.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: But I have some good news as well. Ryuuji from the Bantan Sango Detective Agency tells me that they've found the missing Mr. Nagato.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Is he okay?

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Yes. Badly wounded, but he will live.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: And now that Yuuya is back... it seems like the final ending to this story is a happy one after all.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...I think I know what you want to do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong, Kazuha? Is the blade whispering in your ear again?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes... he said, he wants to take control of me for a brief moment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? No way! Hasn't it learned its lesson?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: He tells me that he's thought of another way to fulfill his maker's wish. And he assures me that he won't use my body for anything nefarious.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I've decided... to let him do it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You...! But...! He...! Ugh, guess there's nothing we can say to change your mind, huh?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Thank you. I will explain my reasons later.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Okay, I am ready. Let us begin, please stay true to your promise.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After leaving the Amenoma Smithy, you learn of the blade's final words from Kazuha.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's why he said it had to be done in that order...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: His consciousness will disappear forever after fulfilling the bladesmith's wish.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: "Kagotsurube Isshin"... It was the first time I ever heard his name.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It seems like deep down, he disapproved of his own actions, and thus chose to bury this name deep within his heart.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Only in the final moments before his consciousness faded was he willing to entrust it to another.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like he really, really wanted to fulfill his maker's wish...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The same fervent ambition that gave him the motivation to keep going forward also fueled the stubborn determination that blinded him to the path ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Speaking for myself, I'd rather see him recognize and atone for his mistakes than see him punished for them.

choices.text: Too dangerous, if you ask me.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I understand. Perhaps this is a flaw in my personality... I've always been captivated by grand aspirations.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hearing his wish to rival the divine light touched something inside of me, just as the sight of those who fought to repeal the Vision Hunt Decree did...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Your quest to face the gods and trace your sibling inspires me in the same way.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: After everything I've seen, perhaps these pursuits fascinate me a little more than they should.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Kazuha...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I will continue to support you from this point on. Know that you will have my assistance whenever you need it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, shouldn't we also go update Kujou Kamaji?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Oh, you're right. We need to tell him about the findings of our investigation.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: And it's also time to give him a response to the offer he made me.

choices.text: I'll hold you to your word!
The remnants of defeated gods are nothing to scoff at.

talks.objective: Accompany Kazuha while he gives Kujou Kamaji his response

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: You have returned! I hear that the issue has been resolved. Though this was a treacherous investigation indeed, we are most fortunate that no lives were lost.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission has already attended to the danger at the warehouse. The investigation into Amenoma Yuuya should conclude soon, I do not believe he will be charged with any crime.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you sure kept your ear to the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Then we needn't recount all the details again. Now, as to your earlier offer, I wish to give you my answer... please take a look at this blade.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: What's this?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: "Kagotsurube Isshin," a weapon crafted using a long-lost blade forging art of the Kaedehara Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: By means of a series of fortuitous events, I was able to recover and restore him. I also promised him that I will continue to study and pass on the secrets of Isshin Art.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: And so, it looks like I will likely continue with my journey across the nations, learning more about this blade as I go.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: I see... I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The Kaedehara Clan has always been a family of bladesmiths, so it is only proper for me to continue on this path.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Were I to accept your goodwill, I may find myself embroiled in conflicts between the Shogunate and Sangonomiya. That would not suit me.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Ah, you misunderstand, that was most certainly not our intent...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I am aware, but I still desire to continue walking my own path.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Very well. I can understand. Then let's pretend this offer was never raised.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: However, if you should ever change your mind, or find yourself in need of the Shogunate's assistance, please do not hesitate to inform me.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Great, thank you for your generosity.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where will you travel to next, Kazuha?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'll probably take to the seas with Captain Beidou again for now.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: As for my next destination...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Let's see where the wind takes me.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Mr. Nagato's survival is the one silver lining in this whole catastrophe.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: We will continue to monitor his condition, and hope he recovers soon.
